economy.summary: As the incumbent, Freeman authored legislation to spur local economic development and housing affordability, including tax incentives to redevelop abandoned factory and mill buildings and a lease-to-purchase program to expand affordable home ownership.
economy.short: Authored factory-reuse tax incentives and affordable home-ownership bills.

taxes.summary: Authored a bill to create a Tax-Exempt Property Municipal Assistance Fund to compensate municipalities with high shares of tax-exempt property, and said the state budget increased education funding without raising state taxes.
taxes.short: Authored tax-exempt-property municipal aid bill; touts no-tax-increase budget.

abortion.summary: Endorsed by Planned Parenthood PA PAC, which backs candidates it calls demonstrated champions who stand on the side of reproductive rights; the endorsement announcement does not detail his specific policy positions.
abortion.short: Endorsed by Planned Parenthood PA PAC as a reproductive-rights champion.

education.summary: Wrote that funding public education is one of state government's most significant responsibilities, called the basic-education funding formula inadequate and noted courts found it unconstitutional, and praised a budget adding more than $1 billion in new K-12 funding without raising state taxes.
education.short: Calls public education funding a top duty; backs fair-funding increases.

energy.summary: Conservation Voters of Pennsylvania, which endorsed him, describes him as a member of the legislature's Climate Caucus who earned a 100% score on its 2019-2020 Pennsylvania Environmental Scorecard.
energy.short: Conservation Voters cites Climate Caucus membership, 100% environmental scorecard.

guns.summary: Endorsed by CeaseFirePA Action, which backs candidates it says will help pass gun-safety policies and put Pennsylvanians' safety before the gun industry; the endorsement does not detail his specific positions.
guns.short: Endorsed by CeaseFirePA Action as a gun-safety champion.

education.summary: Her platform calls for supporting parental rights in education.

energy.summary: Her platform calls for maintaining organic farming standards, an agricultural and environmental-standards issue.
